snippet.title: Stage Tour - Official Reveal Trailer | IGN Fan Fest 2026
snippet.description:
Build your band. Pick your style. Own the stage. Step into the spotlight with Stage Tour, a modern rhythm-action game from RedOctane Games. Stage Tour will be available in fall 2026. More details coming soon, and you can sign up to be notified at stagetour.com if you're interested.

#IGN #Gaming #FanFest
